rules.statement: Where a stranger enters into possession of a divided allotment of property, claiming to be sole owner, although his vendor in fact had legal title only to a share, Corea v. Appuhamy (supra) has no application unless his occupation of the whole was reasonably capable of being understood by the other co-owners as consistent with an acknowledgment of their title.
